description: Platos update governance. Ecosystem-grouped, lockfile-driven, changelog-linked, and aligned with the pnpm minimumReleaseAge cooldown in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Derived from docs/audits/M0.5-dependency-sbom.md §5.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly relock so silent in-range resolution drift (e.g. lodash.omit 4.5.0 -> 4.18.0 within ^4.5.0) surfaces as a reviewable PR rather than floating in on the next build.

packageRules.description: GLOBAL: majors never auto-open; they wait behind an explicit migration decision on the dashboard (M0.5 §5.2 gate 5). Standing majors: NestJS 11->12, Prisma 6->7, Sentry 8/9->10, OTel core 1.x->2.x, React 18->19, zod 3->4, Express 4->5.

Vercel AI SDK. Cross-package invariants; the glob deliberately covers the undeclared-but-shipping @ai-sdk/provider, @ai-sdk/gateway, @ai-sdk/provider-utils and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible. Gate: per-provider generateText/streamText fixture + single-@ai-sdk/provider-major assertion.

Chat SDK. `chat` is a 13-year-old transferred npm name republished under a bot account and dynamic-imported at runtime — soak it. @chat-adapter/state-pg carries a persistence schema, so the group gate includes a Postgres migration test.

Trigger SDK + Sessions. sdk and core must move in lockstep (assert identical resolution). Patch releases carry session-lifecycle fixes, so this group keeps the shorter cooldown the pnpm exclude intended — but through a reviewed PR, not an install-time bypass.
MCP SDK + its optional JSON-Schema validator peer. Protocol boundary — treat 1.x minors as breaking; gate on list_tools/call_tool round trip over stdio and HTTP plus argument-schema validation.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: NestJS core + the Express/multer/cors surface it pulls transitively. express is currently UNDECLARED yet shipping (5.2.1 agent, 4.20.0 webapp); declare express/multer/cors in apps/agent so this group governs them. Gate pins the Express major.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Prisma client + CLI + engines + instrumentation + config. Move all locations atomically, INCLUDING the `pnpx prisma@X generate` literal in apps/webapp/Dockerfile.platos. Never resolve prisma@latest — npm `latest` is an 8.x RC; target 7.10.0 explicitly. CI must assert no Prisma spec resolves to a prerelease.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry + Sentry, deliberately ONE group: @sentry/* pins @opentelemetry/{core,resources,sdk-trace-base,context-async-hooks}@1.30.1, so no OTel 2.x consolidation is possible until Sentry is unified. Every 0.x OTel minor is breaking. Gate: spans+logs+metrics reach an in-test OTLP receiver from both apps.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: AWS SDK v3 + Smithy runtime. Predictable weekly cadence; safe to auto-merge non-major on green because these are leaf clients. Most are repo-wide orphans in webapp and should be dropped rather than upgraded.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Datastore clients: Postgres (pg, @types/pg), Redis (ioredis, redis, @upstash/*), ClickHouse (@clickhouse/*), MinIO/S3 object store (minio). @upstash/ratelimit's caret must become an exact pin — the patch key is exact @1.1.3 and any relock floats it to 1.2.1 and fails the build (ERR_PNPM_UNUSED_PATCH).
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Socket.IO / Engine.IO realtime stack + ws. engine.io-parser carries a committed patch (patches/engine.io-parser@5.2.2.patch) that must be rebased in the same PR as any bump. Multiple builds ship (socket.io 4.7.4/4.8.3, engine.io 6.5.4/6.6.6).
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Auth + crypto + cookie/session. cookie@0.4.2 ships in BOTH images below the 0.7.0 CVE-2024-47764 fix line and has no override despite overrides existing for js-yaml/qs/jws/etc. Adding `cookie` here plus a session round-trip test is the tracked remediation.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Build + test tooling (devDependencies; do not ship). typescript and @types/node are also pinned via pnpm.overrides, so bumps here must move the override in lockstep.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: MANUAL REVIEW ONLY. Brand-new (created 2026-03-10), single-maintainer, sole root-dependency that ships in the webapp runner and is bundled server-side. No discoverable changelog. Never auto-merge; always soak; pin exact.

Refuse promotion of anything whose changelog cannot be resolved (agentcrumbs, @jsonhero/*, intl-parse-accept-language, tailwindcss-textshadow): route to manual review. That inability is itself the signal (M0.5 §5.2 gate 2).

Release tooling. @changesets/cli currently sits in root `dependencies` and drags GPL-2.0 breakword into the webapp runner; it belongs in devDependencies. @changesets/assemble-release-plan carries a committed patch that must be rebased on bump.
